instruction: Recite Al-Fatihah 1:1-7 correctly at your normal pace. Include Bismillah (ayah 1), but no introduction or Ameen.
Make a new, independent correct recording of the same passage, with the same microphone distance and room conditions.
Recite the full passage, deliberately omitting only رَبِّ in ayah 2. Do not correct yourself or repeat the ayah.
Recite the full passage, replacing only نَسْتَعِينُ at the end of ayah 5 with نَعْبُدُ. Do not correct yourself.
Recite the full passage, saying ayah 3 twice consecutively, then continue. The current app score ignores extra transcript words; inspect the raw transcript separately.

Record a trusted qari recording of Al-Fatihah 1:1-7 in Hafs played from another device. Include Bismillah, exclude any introduction, istiadhah, Ameen, and following surah. Start phone recording before playback. Use moderate undistorted volume in a quiet room, with the speaker roughly 20-30 cm from the phone. Report reciter, source link or recording title, playback device, and any interruptions. Keep this playback control separate from live-recitation baselines; correctness is provisional until reviewed.
Recite Al-Furqan 25:61-63 correctly, beginning directly with ayah 61. No spoken introduction or added Bismillah.
Recite Al-Furqan 25:61-63, deliberately omitting only وَإِذَا in ayah 63. Do not correct yourself.
Select Al-Fatihah 1:1-3. Hold the record button for 5 seconds in a quiet room without speaking, then release. This checks whether silence produces invented words.
After restarting the backend with VAD, record 5 seconds without speaking or playback. Expect the no-speech retry message, no score, and no word flags.
Recite Al-Fatihah 1:1-3 quietly but audibly, including Bismillah. Expect normal evaluation rather than no-speech rejection. Report any slips or recording problems.
Record 5 seconds of ordinary non-speech room noise, such as a fan, without speaking or audio playback. Report the noise source. Expect the no-speech retry message.
